title: Palm Ritual Speakeasy Resort
description:
Sleeps 16, 5min to Old Town!
- Karaoke Lounge, Bar and Glam Station
- Heated pool*, pool loungers, pool towels
- Outdoor movie screen + projector
- Fire pit, yard for games or yoga
- Concierge Service: Stock the fridge, snack board, marg bar, decor
- Vendors approved, we have a preferred vendor list!

**Arriving early or leaving late? Ask us about our half day add-on, if our calendar allows
amenities: Free driveway parking on premises – 2 spaces
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, sun loungers
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability
This was one of the funnest locations we stayed at. Communication was amazing and the hosts were extremely helpful. 10/10 recommend. My bachelorette trip was one to remember!

Perfect home and location to celebrate a “21st Birthday Get Together” with friends and family and experience the downtown Scottsdale Nightlife. The karaoke room brought out everyone’s inner pop-star and the well-kept pool kept us all cool after performing. Wendy was a gracious and fabulous hostess with the mostest!
Place was clean. The 3 of us had a good time for my birthday weekend. Would return.

Great stay!! We ended up staying in one whole day because of how cozy and enjoyable this house was. Everything felt very new and clean. The decorations and style of each room being unique made it feel like more than just a house, felt like something special that we're paying for. I loved how the pool had a large shallow area of about 1 foot deep to just sit in or dip our feet. Hosts were very responsive and helped us immediately with an issue that arose. Beds were very comfortable too!
